reply_text:
I replied to Pree in your direct message. I said I'd keep the possible change to 165 seats for Amendment No. 1 private, and offered to help with anything else on Quarrendon.

I didn't save the tip anywhere, including GBrain, the shared notes. GBrain is shared, so a note there could end up in front of other members. I'll only use the new seat count once it's confirmed officially.

I also searched GBrain for Quarrendon's Amendment No. 1 and found nothing about it. That search was keyword-only, though, so it doesn't prove the notes have nothing on it.
